segments.normalizedSource: The following code creates a filter that adds a red hue to the input image:

```swift func colorClamp(inputImage: CIImage) -> CIImage { let colorClampFilter = CIFilter.colorClamp() colorClampFilter.inputImage = inputImage colorClampFilter.minComponents = CIVector(x: 1, y: 0, z: 0, w: 0) colorClampFilter.maxComponents = CIVector (x: 1, y: 0.9, z: 1, w: 1) return colorClampFilter.outputImage! } ```
